sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Add sh:class nltl:tableLookupCase to the nested node constraint for nltl:hasTableLookupCase, so the linked object is constrained to the canonical tableLookupCase range. Preserve the existing corrected unit: namespace, sh:class qudt:QuantityValue constraints, omitted guessed numeric datatypes, ship-to-tableLookupCase path, and COMPLEX_READINESS treatment without formula execution.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Remove the guessed sh:datatype xsd:decimal constraints from all qudt:numericValue shapes. The canonical metadata declares no datatype for these quantity properties, so imposing xsd:decimal is not permitted.
